title: Generator, Alternating Current
description_text: Looking for sources capable of providing the following requirement. Please email XXXX with your capabilities as a request to be considered. For more information, please reference the Source Approval Program located at: https://www.tacom.army.mil/cmo/sap.html NSN: 6115-01-504-0680 Item Name: Generator, Alternating Current Part Number: N1511-1 (76761) Max Quantity:3,713 Response Date: 10/1/2022 The Generator, Alternating Current is an electrical component that delivers 100 amperes of current to the FMTV and on-board electrical components. By working in tandem with the FMTV batteries and engine, the generator, alternating current is the electrical power generator for the vehicle and a critical component in the vehicles electrical system.
